title: Consolidated company names
scope: Company-name discovery and watchlist tasks, including all original and expanded Task 1 company inventories. This is a saved-source name catalog, not a verified list of current employers, openings, fit, or application permission.
usage: Read companies[*].name for the deduplicated names. Use source_tasks to filter by task, aliases for original alternate labels, and provenance to recover exact source rows. This standalone catalog is not automatically loaded into any JobRobo execution configuration.

deduplication.automatic: Unicode NFKC, whitespace normalization and case-insensitive exact labels; no fuzzy, substring, parent-company or domain-only bulk merging.

explicit_decisions.basis: Both Task 1 records explicitly identify the domain braintrust.dev; original labels and IDs are retained.

Task 26 explicitly lists Cursor and Anysphere as aliases of its original watchlist; Task 33 lists Cursor. This is a watchlist identity merge, not a shared application-policy or legal-entity assertion.
Task 45 official-site evidence and Task 33 verified inventory both use the exact Ashby tenant airspace-intelligence.com.

deduplication.grouped_watchlists: Keep original composite company/brand watchlists as a single entry with aliases; counts are watchlist entities, not distinct legal employers.
deduplication.unverified_identity: Saved source names are retained even when identity, access or vacancy coverage is unresolved. identity_requires_review is present only for the nine explicit Task 46 identity holds; its absence does not verify any company identity.
